tools.name: ryla_generate_base_image
tools.description: Generate base character images from a niche/vibe/prompt. Returns a jobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generate_face_swap
tools.description: Swap a character face onto a reference base image. Returns the generation result.

tools.name: ryla_generate_character_sheet
tools.description: Generate a multi-angle character sheet from a base image. Returns a jobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generation_status
tools.description: Check the status of a generation job by its jobId.

tools.name: ryla_account_credits_balance
tools.description: Check the authenticated user's current RYLA credit balance.

tools.name: ryla_account_gallery_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's most recent generated images/jobs.

tools.name: ryla_list_characters
tools.description: List the authenticated user's existing characters (AI influencers) so you can pick a characterId for the other generation tools. There is no tool to CREATE a character -- that happens in the RYLA app at app.ryla.ai.

tools.name: ryla_generate_image
tools.description: Generate Studio-quality images for an existing character with full creative control (scene, outfit, pose, lighting, expression, style). This is the primary, full-featured image tool -- prefer it over ryla_generate_base_image. Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a character

tools.name: ryla_generate_video
tools.description: Generate a Studio video for an existing character (image-to-video). Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId. Returns a jobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generate_voice
tools.description: Generate speech audio (TTS) in an existing character's voice. Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId.

tools.name: ryla_server_info
tools.description: Get RYLA external MCP server configuration and connection info
